Name: Animal Crossing Digspot - Worm Replacement (XNB Mod Update for 1.11)
Author: joyous1ariella
Description:
!!! RED SNOW BEGONE !!!
Thanks so much to FieryChaos for the fix, and to testers Ayriee and ButterShark. See the conversation [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/old-xnb-mod-updates-for-1-11-requests-welcome.127470/]here[/url].

IF YOU ALREADY DOWNLOADED THIS AND ARE HAVING RED PIXELS FALL FROM THE SKY IN WINTER, then you need to re-download/install to fix.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This is a 1.11 compatibility update for Lechet's mod [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18/?]Animal Crossing Digspot - Worm Replacement[/url]. All creds go to them.

[i]*****This will not work with any other mods that change the Cursors.xnb file*****[/i]

Now you can enjoy this mod AND still be able to see Shane's "passed out" sprite! :3

Enjoy!
-Ariella

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Installation:
[list=1]
[*]Navigate to your Stardew Valley game folder and go to the Content-->LooseSprites folder (mine is at C:\GOG Games\Stardew Valley\Content\LosseSprites)
[*]MAKE A COPY OF Cursors.xnb FOR BACKUP!
[*]Extract the .rar to that folder using [url=http://www.rarlab.com/download.htm]WinRar[/url] or similar program and overwrite the file.
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Thanks so much to the testers and to FieryChaos for removing the red snow.
